content:
issue_bank_letter creates an immutable certificate from the current bank profile of an open account. It records account ID, entity, bank version, legal name and issue time.

The certificate copies the bank profile as it exists at issuance. Bank synchronization and platform acceptance are separate operations.

Existing letters are immutable. See OPS-bank-and-legal-identity-aligned for the handling of bank-profile updates.
